[Seat:*]
autologin-user=gbot
autologin-user-timeout=0
user-session=gbot
autologin-session=gbot
xserver-command=X -nolisten tcp

[Desktop Entry]
Name=Gbot XFCE
Exec=/usr/local/bin/gbot-desktop-session
Type=Application
DesktopNames=XFCE

#!/bin/sh
set -eu
export GTK_MODULES=gail:atk-bridge
export QT_ACCESSIBILITY=1
export NO_AT_BRIDGE=0
export PATH=/opt/gbot/bin:$PATH
dbus-update-activation-environment --systemd DISPLAY XAUTHORITY GTK_MODULES QT_ACCESSIBILITY NO_AT_BRIDGE PATH
install -d -m 700 "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/gbot"
umask 077
printf 'DISPLAY=%s\nXAUTHORITY=%s\nDBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=%s\n' "$DISPLAY" "$XAUTHORITY" "$DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS" > "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/gbot/desktop.env"
exec startxfce4

[Desktop Entry]
Type=Application
Name=Gbot desktop view
Exec=/usr/local/bin/gbot-view
OnlyShowIn=XFCE;

PasswordAuthentication no
KbdInteractiveAuthentication no
PermitRootLogin no
X11Forwarding no
AllowUsers gbot
# populated from reviewed artifact URLs and SHA-256 digests
